ticks.note: Someone presses again in the very tick the lift arrives. `Waiting` has only `if arrived go to Idle`: the call is served, and the exit action switches the lamp off. The new press is served by the same lift.
A press while the doors are open: `if button && !arrived` is false in `Idle`, so nothing is registered.
The button is still held as the lift leaves. Now `button && !arrived` is true: the call is registered and the lamp goes on. The chart reacts to levels, and the press is still going on.
